advice.zh-CN: 先学习动作与记录，选择器材齐备且时间可执行的模板。
advice.en: Learn movements and logging; choose a feasible template with the required equipment.

advice.zh-CN: 按弱项、目标与恢复分配训练，不因级别更高而无限加量。
advice.en: Allocate work to goals and recovery, not unlimited volume because of experience.

advice.zh-CN: 先考虑可执行性、关节耐受、伴随疾病与体成分指标。
advice.en: Consider feasibility, joint tolerance, associated conditions and composition outcomes.

advice.zh-CN: 加入平衡与功能；本版只提供教育分流，不生成自动处方。
advice.en: Include balance and function; educational routing only in this release.

advice.zh-CN: 保护生长与技能发展；不使用成人减脂及BMI阈值。
advice.en: Protect development and skills; do not use adult fat-loss plans or BMI thresholds.

advice.zh-CN: 先根据产科评估和症状适配，不自动推荐减脂。
advice.en: Adapt to obstetric assessment and symptoms; no automatic fat-loss recommendation.

advice.zh-CN: 用药和并发症必须纳入，不在线调药。
advice.en: Account for medication and complications; no online medication changes.

advice.zh-CN: 交由相关专业人员明确运动限制、监测与营养要求。
advice.en: A relevant professional should establish limits, monitoring and nutrition needs.

name.zh-CN: 疼痛 / 损伤 / 术后

advice.zh-CN: 先分流和明确诊断；不从部位关键词直接套康复动作。
advice.en: Triage and clarify diagnosis; do not prescribe rehab from a body-part keyword.

advice.zh-CN: 按可达性、支撑、转移与个体能力适配，不用统一模板。
advice.en: Adapt reach, support, transfers and individual ability rather than using one template.

advice.zh-CN: 按当前能力回归，既往伤病另行评估。
advice.en: Resume at current capacity; previous injuries need separate assessment.

name.zh-CN: 进食障碍风险 / 体重焦虑

advice.zh-CN: 关闭自动减脂和体重追踪，优先合格专业支持。
advice.en: Do not use automatic fat-loss plans or weight tracking; prioritize qualified support.
